tasks.answer: The 航班延误补偿批次工作区 page is flight-delay.FlightDelayCompensationBatchScreen, imported from @/features/flight-delay-compensation/batch-detail-screen. The only required prop is batchId (it identifies the batch to load). The screen is a batch compensation workspace for standard, special and review steps; its constraint notes it needs query, auth and router providers and handles offline/conflict states.

No dedicated 特殊旅客预订列表 (special-passenger booking list) variant exists in the catalog. The only booking-list component returned is the general bookings.TravelerBookingListScreen from @/features/traveler-bookings/booking-list-screen, required prop navigate; initialStatus is optional, and its queries/actions are permission-gated. It is described as a paginated traveler booking list with search and filters, not a special-traveler-specific variant.

Password input is auth.PasswordInput from @/features/auth/password-input; it has no required props. It renders the password field with show/hide labels and a form-field error, but it must be used inside UiFormField: the error is a string passed to/shown by the field wrapper (the UiFormField wrapper renders the error message), not by an error prop of its own.

The mobile booking list search bar is business.SearchBar and the filter panel is business.FilterSheet; both are shared-ui components imported from @/components/business/mobile. SearchBar required props: value, placeholder, onChange (onFilter is optional and adds the filter icon button). FilterSheet required props: visible, title, children, onClose (onConfirm runs before the sheet closes); it is a bottom filter sheet with reset and confirm actions.

The global 认证恢复弹窗 is common.AuthRecoveryDialog from @/components/common/auth-recovery-dialog; it takes no required props. Mounting: mount it exactly once near the app root. It subscribes to the auth recovery store and lazily renders its view, and renders null while no recovery event is pending. (The inner presentational view is common.AuthRecoveryDialogView from @/components/common/auth-recovery-dialog-view, which requires detail, but it is not what is mounted globally.)
